purpose: Teach: メタデータ/主眼/採る/価額/常設/工学科/多面/製作所

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文のメタデータを正確に記入しろ
lines.en: Ren — get the paper metadata filled in accurately.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Clear directive with the weight of someone who knows what matters. Speaks at normal pace, decisive. Expects compliance without drama.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の主眼を新発見に置きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the paper's focus is on the new findings.
lines.style: Eager to confirm understanding. Slightly quick, showing readiness to act. Respectful but not obsequious — matching his energy back. A nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究者を国際的に採るぞ
lines.en: Ren — we're bringing in international collaborators.
lines.style: Declarative. Not asking for input but informing. Steady, confident tone. Slight emphasis on the scope ('international'). The voice of someone making a decision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究機材の価額を予算と比較しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already compared the equipment costs against the budget.
lines.style: Quick, almost relieved — anticipating what he needs. Shows initiative without boasting. Clipped slightly, efficient. The voice of someone staying ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室に常設の実験室を作れ
lines.en: Ren — set up a permanent experimental setup in the lab.
lines.style: Another directive, delivered with the same clarity as the first. Slightly broader scope here — this is a bigger ask. Steady pace, no rush. Expects execution.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。工学科の同窓会で発表しました
lines.en: Yes. I presented the preliminary results at the engineering alumni meeting.
lines.style: Warm pulse underneath — he's already done more than was asked. Quick delivery showing momentum. Slight lift at the end, looking for acknowledgment but not demanding it. Pride kept small.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文で多面的な分析を示せ
lines.en: Ren — show multifaceted analysis in the paper.
lines.style: Clear, measured instruction. The tone of someone raising the bar deliberately. Speaks at normal pace, intent on precision. This is the kind of directive that takes thought to execute.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試料製作所と連携して論文を仕上げます
lines.en: Yes. I'm coordinating with the sample fabrication facility to bring the paper to completion.
lines.style: Earnest closing note. Slightly slower, thoughtful — showing the weight of all the pieces coming together. Measured confidence. Soft but firm on the final syllables, a sense of closure without finality.
